about_short_description.short_description: Blaxel is a cloud infrastructure to deploy and scale AI agents.

product.name: Blaxel Platform
product.description: A serverless platform for AI agent developers to build, deploy, and scale agents using any Python or TypeScript framework without infrastructure management.

product.name: Sandboxed VMs
product.description: Isolated virtual machines that allow AI agents to autonomously run code and commands with persistent state and low latency boot times.

product.name: Global Agentics Network
product.description: A production-grade network that connects AI agents and enables running code on flexible computing infrastructure with scalable resources.

product.name: AI Gateway
product.description: A unified gateway providing access to multiple large language models (LLMs) from top providers and self-hosted models with centralized access control and routing.

product.name: MCP Servers
product.description: Cloud-hosted servers that run asynchronous tool calls for AI agents, available as pre-built or customizable servers.
